summary.headline: 1000000159: 6 of 23 documented 99214 and 99215 claims (26%) are documented below the billed level
summary.rationale: 1000000159 billed 99215 on 4.7% of 1,948 claims against an expected 4.1% given patient complexity (risk-adjusted score 0.35; plain z-score vs peers -0.40). 55% of this provider's 99215 claims were on patients with 0 or 1 chronic conditions. Records came back for 30 claims. No documented 99215 claims came back. Note checks on 30 returned notes (share showing each sign): problems 30%, late 7%, unsigned 0%, data 3%. No audit trail was received. 2 of 14 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab or test line on the claim. This pattern is consistent with upcoding. It is a reason to review the records, not a finding. Examples: C0080447: billed 99214; documented MDM level low, minutes not recorded. C0080557: billed 99214; documented MDM level low, minutes not recorded. C0080560: billed 99214; documented MDM level low, minutes not recorded.
